title: Open public data and stock price delay: evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China

abstract: Stock price delay serves as a key metric of information efficiency in stock markets, and identifying its determinants is essential for promoting market information efficiency. This study examines the effect of open public data (OPD) on stock price delay. Using the staggered adoption of city-level OPD portals in China as a quasi-natural experiment, our difference-in-differences analysis finds that OPD significantly reduces stock price delay, with an economic magnitude representing approximately 7.9% of its standard deviation. Cross-sectional analyses demonstrate that this effect is more pronounced when (1) public data on OPD portals are of higher quality, (2) public data are more relevant to firm operations, (3) public data are less substitutable, (4) investors have greater information processing capacity, and (5) firms’ information disclosure quality is lower. Additional tests show that OPD implementation is associated with improved liquidity, reduced return volatility, and diminished information content of earnings announcements. This study makes a valuable contribution to the literature on the determinants of stock price delay and the economic consequences of OPD, while offering insights for policymakers seeking to enhance market information efficiency and assess the effectiveness of OPD initiatives. 1 Under the Chinese institutional setting, a firm’s registered city generally coincides with the location of its headquarters rather than merely serving as a legal place of incorporation. According to the Company Law of the People’s Republic of China and the Regulations on the Administration of Market Entities Registration , a company’s registered domicile must correspond to the location of its principal administrative office, and firms relocating their principal office are required to update their registration accordingly (Chen, Hung, and Wang Citation 2018). Consequently, firms’ registered cities generally represent the locations of their headquarters. Because local governments in China play an active role in firms’ operations and are responsible for taxation, administrative approvals, industrial policy implementation, regulatory oversight, and other aspects of the local business environment (Xu Citation 2011), firms’ registered cities also represent the local institutional and information environments surrounding their headquarters. 3 GF Securities has developed an enterprise financial intelligent early-warning platform based on large-scale pre-trained models, which leverages public data and artificial intelligence to identify corporate financial risks at earlier stages and with greater accuracy. Similarly, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange’s blockchain-based industry risk data sharing project enhances the secure sharing of risk information across market participants, enabling investors to better assess industry-level risks. The Shanghai Equity Exchange has introduced a blockchain-based equity registration, custody, and transfer service platform that integrates multi-source data and provides more objective valuation benchmarks for investors in equity markets. abstract_zh: 股票价格延迟是衡量股票市场信息效率的关键指标，识别其决定因素对于促进市场信息效率至关重要。本研究考察了开放公共数据（OPD）对股票价格延迟的影响。利用中国城市级OPD门户网站的分阶段采纳作为准自然实验，我们的双重差分分析发现，OPD显著降低了股票价格延迟，其经济幅度约占其标准差7.9%。横截面分析表明，当（1）OPD门户网站上的公共数据质量更高，（2）公共数据与企业运营更相关，（3）公共数据的可替代性较低，（4）投资者的信息处理能力更强，以及（5）企业的信息披露质量较低时，这一效应更为显著。附加测试显示，OPD的实施与流动性改善、回报波动性降低以及盈余公告信息含量减少相关联。本研究为股票价格延迟决定因素及OPD经济后果的文献做出了有价值的贡献，同时为旨在提升市场信息效率和评估OPD举措有效性的政策制定者提供了见解。¹ 在中国制度背景下，企业的注册城市通常与其总部所在地一致，而非仅仅作为法定注册地。根据《中华人民共和国公司法》和《市场主体登记管理条例》，公司的注册住所必须与其主要办事机构所在地相符，企业迁移主要办事机构时需相应更新注册信息（Chen, Hung, and Wang Citation 2018）。因此，企业的注册城市通常代表其总部所在地。由于中国地方政府在企业运营中发挥积极作用，并负责税收、行政审批、产业政策实施、监管监督以及地方商业环境其他方面的事务（Xu Citation 2011），企业的注册城市也代表了其总部周边的本地制度和信息环境。³ 广发证券基于大规模预训练模型开发了企业财务智能预警平台，该平台利用公共数据和人工智能，以更早阶段和更高准确性识别企业财务风险。类似地，深圳证券交易所基于区块链的行业风险数据共享项目增强了市场参与者之间风险信息的安全共享，使投资者能够更好地评估行业层面风险。上海股权交易所推出了基于区块链的股权登记、托管和转让服务平台，该平台整合多源数据，为股权市场投资者提供更客观的估值基准。更多详情，请参见 https://www.csrc.gov.cn/shanxi/c106408/c7568249/content.shtml、https://jrj.sh.gov.cn/SC212/20241023/7f10aa43b0424212b06e0385adaece26.html 和 https://finance.stockstar.com/IG2024102200029365.shtml。⁴ 在本研究中，由于样本仅限于中国A股市场，企业-日观测值等同于证券-日观测值。方程Eq. (1) (1) $\mathit{Re} t {\mathit{i} , \mathit{d}} \textrm{ } = \textrm{ }\textrm{ } a {i} \textrm{ } + \textrm{ }\textrm{ } b {i} \mathit{R} M {d} \textrm{ } + \textrm{ } \sum {\mathit{n} \textrm{ } = \textrm{ }\textrm{ } 1}^{5} c {\mathit{i} , n} \mathit{R} M {\mathit{d} - \mathit{n}} \textrm{ } + \textrm{ }\textrm{ } \epsilon {\mathit{i} , \mathit{d}} ,$(1) 中使用的个股回报和市场回报均仅基于A股证券。尽管部分企业也在H股或B股市场上市，但这些上市并未纳入我们的分析。⁵ 我们将GDPManage计算为Lyu等人（Citation 2018）分解模型残差的负绝对值。$\mathit{GDPGrowth} = \mathit{\alpha} + \beta {1} \Delta \mathit{Electricity} + \beta {2} \Delta \mathit{Freight} + \beta {3} \Delta \mathit{Loan} + \mathit{\epsilon}$。其中GDPGrowth表示GDP的年增长率。∆Electricity、∆Freight和∆Loan分别表示电力消费、公路货运量和金融机构贷款的同比变化，各自按上一年GDP进行缩放。因此，GDPManage计算为–| ε |。GDPManage值越大，表明GDP管理水平越低，对应更高的公共数据质量。⁶ 我们还根据外国销售额占总销售额的比例对企业进行分组。未列表结果显示，OPD对股票价格延迟的影响在外销比例较低的企业中显著更强，这与基于Distribution的结果相似。⁷ 遵循Easley、López de Prado和O’Hara（Citation 2012）的方法，我们首先使用以下方程构建每日VPIN指标。$\mathit{VPIN} = \frac{\sum {\tau = 1}^{n} \left|V {\tau}^{B} - V {\tau}^{S}\right|}{\mathit{nV}}$。买入和卖出量估计为。$V {\tau}^{B} = \sum {\mathit{i} = \mathit{t} \left(\mathit{\tau} - 1\right) + 1}^{\mathit{t} \left(\right. \mathit{\tau} \left.\right)} V {i} \times \mathit{Z} \left(\frac{P {i} - P {\mathit{i} - 1}}{\sigma {ΔP}}\right)$。$V {\tau}^{S} = \sum {\mathit{i} = \mathit{t} \left(\mathit{\tau} - 1\right) + 1}^{\mathit{t} \left(\right. \mathit{\tau} \left.\right)} V {i} \times \mathit{Z} \left[1 - \mathit{Z} \left(\frac{P {i} - P {\mathit{i} - 1}}{\sigma {\Delta \mathit{P}}}\right)\right] = \mathit{V} - V {\tau}^{B}$。其中t ( τ )表示桶τ中包含的最后一个一分钟区间；V i 是第i分钟的交易量；P i 是第i分钟的交易价格；σ Δ P 是一分钟价格变化的标准差；Z (⋅)表示标准正态分布的累积分布函数；n表示等量桶的数量，我们选择n = 50；V表示每个桶中包含的量。最后，我们将企业年度VPIN计算为每个财政年度内所有每日VPIN值的平均值。⁸ Amihud（Citation 2002）非流动性比率计算为每日绝对回报率（以百分比计）与每日交易量（以亿元人民币计）之比的年度平均值。尽管买卖价差是股票流动性的常用代理指标，但我们未使用该指标，因为中国股票市场中大多数买卖价差等于1分钱（Xu, Xuan, and Zheng Citation 2021）。

title: Pollution Pricing in Equilibrium: Production, Reallocation, and Aggregate Impacts

title_primary: 均衡中的污染定价：生产、再配置与总体影响

authors: R. Andrew Butters, Jackson Dorsey, Ivan Rudik
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How much does pricing pollution cut aggregate emissions, and at what cost? We develop a microfounded equilibrium model of firm production and abatement that can be estimated from standard firm financial and emissions data, without observing abatement effort directly. The model captures three adjustment margins: short-run input substitution, reallocation of output from dirty to cleaner firms, and long-run clean technology adoption. Applying it to the first 17 years of the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU-ETS), we find input substitution is rigid: firms cannot cut emissions in the short run without cutting output. Reallocation instead drives nearly all of the short-run aggregate emissions response, concentrated in sectors with heterogeneous emissions intensities, like power and cement, or with elastic demand, like refining. Clean technology adoption also responds causally to permit price shocks, reducing firms’ emissions intensity over the five years that follow. Doubling the permit price cuts aggregate emissions 23% in the short run and 31% in the longer run after induced clean technology adoption. In the short run, output falls by 4%, primarily because carbon costs pass from upstream polluting industries like electricity to downstream producers. In the long run, output falls just 2.5%, as clean technology adoption dampens these supply-chain impacts. Carbon pricing thus delivers substantial emissions reductions with moderate output effects, and much of the economic burden falls on downstream firms through higher upstream input costs.
abstract_zh: 污染定价能在多大程度上减少总体排放，其成本又是多少？我们构建了一个基于微观基础的企业生产与减排均衡模型，该模型可利用标准的企业财务和排放数据进行估计，而无需直接观测减排努力。模型涵盖了三种调整途径：短期投入替代、产出从高污染企业向清洁企业的重新配置，以及长期清洁技术采纳。将其应用于欧盟排放交易体系（EU-ETS）前17年的数据，我们发现投入替代具有刚性：企业在短期内无法在不削减产出的情况下减少排放。相反，重新配置驱动了几乎所有短期总体排放响应，且集中于排放强度异质性显著的行业（如电力和水泥）或需求弹性较大的行业（如炼油）。清洁技术采纳也对配额价格冲击产生因果性响应，在随后的五年中降低了企业的排放强度。将配额价格翻倍，短期内可使总体排放减少23%，在诱导清洁技术采纳后的较长时期内减少31%。短期内，产出下降4%，主要原因是碳成本从电力等上游污染行业传导至下游生产者。长期来看，产出仅下降2.5%，因为清洁技术采纳缓解了这些供应链影响。因此，碳定价能在产出影响适中的情况下实现显著的减排效果，且大部分经济负担通过上游投入成本上升而落在下游企业身上。

abstract: How do organizations adapt internally when ethnic divisions intensify? We develop a model in which organizations jointly choose managerial appointments and delegation when locally matched managers have better information but are less aligned with headquarters, and test it using a panel of Ethiopian bank branches. Exploiting variation in banks’ exposure to ethnic conflict across their branch networks, we find that conflict increases the appointment of locally matched managers, while reducing lending autonomy and leaving branch credit mostly unaffected. Conflict-exposed branches are more likely to be staffed by insiders reassigned within the bank. An LLM-based CEO vignette exercise corroborates this mechanism.
abstract_zh: 当族群分歧加剧时，组织如何在内部进行调整？我们构建了一个模型，在该模型中，组织在本地匹配的经理拥有更佳信息但与总部一致性较低的情况下，共同决定管理任命与授权，并利用一组埃塞俄比亚银行分支机构的面板数据进行检验。通过利用银行分支网络对族群冲突暴露程度的差异，我们发现冲突增加了本地匹配经理的任命，同时减少了贷款自主权，而分支信贷基本未受影响。受冲突影响的分支更可能由银行内部重新调配的内部人员任职。一项基于LLM的CEO情境模拟练习进一步证实了这一机制。

abstract: This paper presents estimates of income concentration and inequality for Norway using a new comprehensive measure of income, which identifies business income as it is earned by companies rather than when it is paid out as dividends to owners. We assemble several sources of high quality register data that allow us to account for multiple layers of business ownership across all companies between 2001 and 2018. Compared to official statistics, the new measure implies that the share of income attributable to the top 1% of the distribution more than doubles and the Gini coefficient estimates increase by about 40%. Our new measure identifies substantial tax regressivity for individuals in the top percentile, a feature that cannot be detected by standard income measures. For instance, while the share of gross income paid in taxes by individuals at the 99th percentile is about 36% in 2016, the corresponding share paid by individuals in the top 1% is 19%.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一种新的综合性收入衡量指标，对挪威的收入集中度与不平等状况进行了估算。该指标在企业赚取商业收入时即予以确认，而非待其以股息形式分配给所有者时才计入。我们整合了多个高质量登记数据来源，能够覆盖2001年至2018年间所有公司多层级的商业所有权结构。与官方统计数据相比，新指标显示，收入分配顶端1%人群所占收入份额增加了一倍以上，基尼系数估计值也上升了约40%。我们的新指标揭示了顶端百分位个体面临的显著税收累退性，这一特征在标准收入衡量指标下无法显现。例如，2016年，处于第99百分位的个体所缴纳的税款占其总收入的比重约为36%，而顶端1%个体对应的这一比例仅为19%。

abstract: The increasing integration of agricultural commodity markets and growing external uncertainty have made risk transmission along China’s hog–feed supply chain an important issue for agricultural risk management. This study investigates the tail-risk spillovers between China’s live hog futures and five major feed futures (No. 1 soybean, No. 2 soybean, soybean meal, soybean oil, and corn) using daily data from January 2021 to July 2025. The quantile Granger causality test, the Multivariate Multiple-Quantile Conditional Autoregressive Value at Risk (MVMQ-CAViaR) model, and quantile impulse response analysis are employed to examine cross-market dependence under extreme market conditions. The results show that significant tail dependence exists between live hog and feed futures, with spillover patterns varying across commodities and quantiles. The MVMQ-CAViaR estimates reveal heterogeneous and state-dependent cross-market interactions. Subsample analysis indicates that the Russia–Ukraine conflict altered the pattern of tail-risk transmission rather than uniformly strengthening spillovers across markets. Quantile impulse responses further show that feed-market shocks generate short-run responses that gradually converge to equilibrium. These findings provide new evidence on tail-risk transmission within China’s hog–feed futures system and offer implications for agricultural risk management and futures market regulation. abstract: Understanding the role of international trade in sustainable manufacturing development is a critical area of industrial research. This study investigates the impact of imports on manufacturing development within a sustainable framework encompassing economic, environmental, and social dimensions. Using city-level panel data from Guangdong Province, China, we find that imports have a positive impact on sustainable manufacturing development. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that this positive effect is more pronounced for labour-intensive and technology-intensive imports, midstream imports along the supply chain, and in cities with greater sectoral complexity within the manufacturing sector. abstract: We develop a model of bias and information loss in supervisory communication and apply it to evaluate a policy reform that delegated supervisory decision-making authority over a subset of bank branches to a lower level. abstract: This study examines how young adults respond to local labor market disruptions caused by military base closures in Sweden between 1998 and 2005. The results show substantial differences in responses between men and women, reflecting the sharp gender imbalance in military roles. Affected men increase enrollment in tertiary education, particularly when living in proximity to higher education institutions. In contrast, women experience improved labor market outcomes a few years after a closure, with higher earnings and employment rates. This suggests that the structural transformation of the local labor market, following the exit of a major male‐dominated employer, benefits young women as they transition into employment in expanding sectors.

title: Volatile urbanism: Rethinking planning beyond the stability premise

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Contemporary land use policy rests on a foundational and insufficiently examined premise that the exogenous operating environment of cities will remain within historically derived parameters adequate for extrapolative planning. This paper terms that premise the stability premise and argues that its structural dissolution constitutes not a series of correctable policy failures but a fundamental reconfiguration in the conditions under which urban governance operates. The concept of Volatile Urbanismis introduced to theorise that transformation: defined as the structural condition produced when disruptions to urban operating systems arrive with a velocity, simultaneity, and cross-systemic compounding that systematically exceeds the adaptive capacity of the institutions governing those cities. Three constitutive properties are identified and theorised: (i) transmission without proximity, (ii) compounding rather than sequential disruption, and (iii) institutional lag as the primary vulnerability mechanism, with implications for urban finance, infrastructure insurance, public health systems, and municipal fiscal governance. The framework is distinguished from the cognate concepts of fragility, vulnerability, and resilience, including its most sophisticated reformulations through transformative and evolutionary resilience theory, against which it offers a theoretically bounded contribution focused on the velocity-institution mismatch as a distinct governance failure mode. Specific implications are developed for zoning and land classification, infrastructure investment appraisal, development planning, and urban finance. The paper argues that land use policy is both the domain in which the stability premise is most durably encoded and the most consequential site for its reformulation. The framework arrives at a moment when the 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure, the 2023–2024 Red Sea shipping crisis, and the compound urban consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic have made the theoretical inadequacy of existing frameworks empirically evident. abstract_zh: 当代土地利用政策建立在一个基础性但未经充分检验的前提之上，即城市的外生运行环境将维持在历史参数范围内，足以支撑外推式规划。本文将这一前提称为“稳定性前提”，并认为其结构性瓦解并非一系列可纠正的政策失误，而是城市治理运行条件发生的根本性重构。本文引入“波动城市主义”概念来理论化这一转变：将其定义为当城市运行系统受到的冲击以某种速度、同时性及跨系统复合效应系统性超出治理这些城市的制度适应能力时所产生的结构性状态。本文识别并理论化了三个构成性属性：（i）无需邻近即可传播，（ii）复合而非序列性冲击，以及（iii）制度滞后作为主要脆弱性机制，并探讨其对城市财政、基础设施保险、公共卫生系统及市政财政治理的影响。该框架与脆弱性、易损性和韧性等相近概念相区分，包括通过变革性韧性理论和演化韧性理论进行的最为复杂的重新表述，并在此基础上提供了一个理论边界明确的贡献，聚焦于速度-制度错配作为一种独特的治理失效模式。本文进一步探讨了该框架对区划与土地分类、基础设施投资评估、发展规划及城市财政的具体影响。本文认为，土地利用政策既是稳定性前提被最持久编码的领域，也是对其进行重构的最关键场域。该框架提出的时机恰逢2026年霍尔木兹海峡关闭、2023-2024年红海航运危机以及COVID-19大流行带来的复合城市后果，使得现有框架的理论不足在经验上变得显而易见。

abstract: Sustainable agricultural practices such as cover cropping can improve soil health, water quality, and carbon sequestration, yet U.S. adoption remains limited due to economic and operational barriers. We evaluate market and economic impacts of integrating perennial groundcover into U.S. corn and soybean production under six yield and cost scenarios. Results show that impacts depend on whether yields are maintained and costs remain stable. Under the most optimistic scenario, long‐term outcomes remain close to or slightly above baseline levels. abstract: We estimate the association between high-stakes exams and student suicides in India using geocoded, high-frequency media data. Student suicides rise by 17.5 percent during NEET-UG or JEE-Mains exam months, with no comparable pattern around lower-stakes board exams or among adults. Stronger associations are seen among girls. Associations being higher in high-participation states, urbanised districts, and in months when high-stakes and board exams coincide suggest that peer pressure and economic incentives in highly competitive environments may worsen mental health. Using cyclone and election months as potential drivers of media attention, we rule out media bias driving our results. Event-study estimates show suicides concentrating in months before and during exams, with a weaker association around result announcements. While falsification exercises strengthen our findings, Oster Bounds analysis addresses potential omitted variable bias. Lacking granular mental health data, we generate an alternative database to address a key policy question that can spur future research.

abstract: We develop a Transmission Growth-at-Risk (TGaR) framework that incorporates foreign financial vulnerabilities as predictors of U.S. downside growth risk. We distinguish financial conditions, which measure current tightness in credit markets, from financial vulnerabilities, which measure structural fragilities that can amplify shocks. Elevated foreign financial vulnerabilities are associated with lower U.S. growth-at-risk, with transmission through both trade linkages and dollar integration channels. Asset valuation pressures and financial sector leverage abroad have the largest estimated amplification effects. Financial conditions primarily affect near-term tail risk, while foreign vulnerabilities weigh on U.S. GDP at a medium-term horizon. Out of sample, adding foreign vulnerabilities raises the predictive score by 53 percent at the 8-quarter horizon. Crisis-episode evidence points to the same interpretation. These findings show that monitoring foreign financial vulnerabilities is important for gauging U.S. growth prospects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个“传导增长风险”（TGaR）框架，将外国金融脆弱性纳入美国下行增长风险的预测变量。我们区分了金融状况（衡量信贷市场当前紧缩程度）与金融脆弱性（衡量可能放大冲击的结构性脆弱性）。外国金融脆弱性升高与美国增长风险下降相关，其传导渠道包括贸易联系和美元一体化路径。海外资产估值压力与金融部门杠杆率具有最大的放大效应估计值。金融状况主要影响短期尾部风险，而外国脆弱性则在中期时间范围内对美国GDP产生压力。在样本外检验中，加入外国脆弱性指标后，8个季度预测期的预测评分提升了53%。危机时期的证据也指向相同解释。这些发现表明，监测外国金融脆弱性对于评估美国增长前景至关重要。

The authors preferred the single pass, by 0.66 rank points over mad-research (95% CI 0.32 to 1.00) and 0.57 over paper-workshop (0.16 to 0.95), though paper-workshop spent roughly thirty times the tokens. Authors who recalled their journal referee report usually placed it first and never last; in a separate exercise, three AI judges almost always placed the real journal referee report last. Among the three AI reports, Gemini (the judge whose model family wrote none of the reports) would have ranked paper-workshop first in the authors' place, reversing the single-pass preference. The reversal warns against substituting an AI judge for the author. We measure perceived usefulness for finished papers; whether AI should referee papers is a separate question.

abstract: Cost-of-living shocks can have large and unequal effects, but causal evidence on households’ adaptive responses is scarce. Using Finnish administrative microdata from the 2022 energy crisis, we exploit variation in electricity contract expirations to identify behavioral responses in electricity use, labor earnings, financial distress, and residual consumption and savings. We find notable heterogeneity in responses that shape the final incidence: high-income households primarily reduced electricity consumption, while low-income households reduced consumption less, responding instead through increased labor supply, more payment defaults, and cutbacks in spending and savings. Longer anticipation softens but does not eliminate these impacts.

abstract: This study develops a theoretical framework to examine the welfare effects of scale transition from smallholders to large farms. Taking hog farming in China as an example, this study focuses on the coexistence equilibrium with both smallholders and large farms and assesses the distributional effects on rural households (independent smallholders, employed smallholders, and quitters), urban consumers, and aggregate social welfare. The simulation findings reveal that the transition to large farms results in long‐term welfare losses for employed smallholsers, as well as rural households as a whole. This outcome is attributed to a reversed income effect, whereby the initial employment gains gradually diminish as the scale of transition progresses. Conversely, urban consumers gain substantial welfare improvements owing to lower retail pork prices, which are driven by the credit advantages and technological innovations of large farms. Additionally, aggregate social welfare improves as consumer surplus outpaces smallholder welfare losses. This research unpacks the intermediary step in the transition from smallholders to large farms and provides theoretical insights for agricultural transitions in developing economies.

abstract: We study how partisan newspaper ownership shapes news content, media demand, and policy preferences. Our setting is the 2010 takeover of the Basler Zeitung, a leading Swiss regional daily, by owners affiliated with the conservative Swiss People's Party (SVP), and its 2018 sale to a nonpartisan media group. We combine over three million articles from six German-language Swiss newspapers with municipality-level circulation data and outcomes from 160 federal referendums over twenty years. Using difference-in-differences designs that compare the Basler Zeitung to control-group newspapers and exploit cross-municipality variation in pre-takeover penetration, we trace the effects of ownership along the full chain from content to readership and voting. Partisan ownership shifts coverage toward the SVP platform, especially before referendum votes and on party-sponsored proposals. Circulation declines by 28.8 percent during partisan ownership. Losses are largest in historically left-aligned municipalities, but exposure to the newspaper remains substantial even there. At mean pre-takeover penetration, partisan ownership increases SVP-aligned vote shares by 0.34 percentage points across all referendums, implying a persuasion rate of 14.6 percent among retained, persuadable readers, with larger effects for referendums closely tied to the party platform. Overall, ownership induces both ideological sorting in media demand and persuasion among voters who remain exposed, with political effects concentrated in local environments where SVP positions are more prevalent or less strongly opposed.
abstract_zh: 本文研究党派报纸所有权如何塑造新闻内容、媒体需求及政策偏好。研究背景为2010年瑞士主要地区日报《巴塞尔报》被与保守派瑞士人民党有关联的所有者收购，以及2018年该报被出售给无党派媒体集团。我们整合了六家德语瑞士报纸的三百余万篇文章、市级发行量数据及二十年间160次联邦公投结果。通过双重差分设计（将《巴塞尔报》与对照组报纸比较，并利用收购前渗透率的跨市差异），我们追踪了所有权从内容到读者群再到投票行为的完整影响链条。党派所有权使报道向瑞士人民党纲领倾斜，尤其在公投投票前及政党提案相关议题上。党派所有权期间发行量下降28.8%，历史上左倾市镇的损失最大，但即使在这些地区，报纸曝光度仍保持较高水平。在收购前平均渗透率条件下，党派所有权使所有公投中支持瑞士人民党的投票比例增加0.34个百分点，这意味着在保留的可说服读者中说服率为14.6%，且对与政党纲领紧密相关的公投影响更大。总体而言，所有权既引发媒体需求中的意识形态分化，也对持续接触信息的选民产生说服效应，其政治影响集中于瑞士人民党立场更普遍或反对力度较弱的本地环境。

abstract: This paper develops a general theory to recover the inverse welfare function that rationalizes a given tax schedule as optimal. Our theory allows for complex environments including the presence of multidimensional tax schedules, bunching/jumping behavior, optimization frictions, general equilibrium effects, and externalities. We show that inverse welfare functions can be used to test for Pareto efficiency, construct Pareto improving reforms, and characterize the set of welfare improving local reforms, thereby extending previous results to more general environments. abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investment has moved in less than a decade from dominant paradigm to contested terrain. This paper examines the rise and recent retreat of ESG in corporate governance and financial markets. We document a marked decline in ESG engagement across corporate commitments, investor coalitions, and corporate communications. While the backlash is most visible in the United States, similar patterns appear globally, indicating deeper structural weaknesses in the ESG model. ESG relied heavily on voluntary coordination and the promise that firms could “do well by doing good”—claims that proved fragile under political and market pressure. We argue that sustainability efforts should refocus on environmental risk through a narrower framework: Transition, Emissions, and Resource Risk Accountability (TERRA).

abstract: Utilities have invested billions of dollars in advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) but proceeded slowly to deploy AMI-enabled programs that benefit consumers. abstract: The well-known cashless-limiting result in Woodford (1998) has become the theoretical foundation for a large body of work that treats the costs and benefits of holding money as irrelevant for monetary transmission. abstract: The 2026 IranWar has raised the question of how exposed the U.S. economy is to geopolitical oil supply disruptions. abstract: Germany’s economy experienced a pronounced recession during 2023–24, with real GDP contracting and growth falling notably behind the rest of the euro area. This paper systematically examines the underlying causes of this downturn using four complementary approaches. We find that about 60 percent of Germany’s growth underperformance was due to lower potential growth while about 40 percent reflected cyclical factors. The downturn was broad-based, with nearly all major expenditure categories—but particularly investment and exports—weighing on activity. On the production side, the recession was concentrated in manufacturing and construction, which together accounted for the bulk of the growth gap relative to the euro area. The analysis further shows that the decline in output was driven primarily by falling productivity, especially in industry and construction, rather than by a reduction in hours worked. This decline in productivity partly reflected cyclical labor hoarding amid weak aggregate demand. However, structural challenges—including (i) longer-term subdued productivity growth due to structural factors such as persistent underinvestment in public infrastructure, skills, and innovation as well as excessive red tape; (ii) population aging; (iii) one-off adverse effects from the 2022 energy-price shock, and (iv) deteriorating external competitiveness (although the level of the current account surplus remains substantial)—amplified the cyclical downturn.

We develop a theory of market-access costs in which firms weigh the managerial strain of internal provision against adaptation costs of outsourcing—a mechanism that receives empirical sup-port. Further explorations reveal that outsourcing market-access services helps explain variation in access costs related to gravity and extended gravity, affects both sunk and fixed export costs, and substantially amplifies the variety gains from trade liberalization.
abstract_zh: 随着制造业企业全球扩张，广告和法律支持等商业服务成为进入新市场的关键。利用外生需求冲击，我们发现法国制造商在进入更多目的地市场时，会越来越多地将市场准入服务外包。我们构建了一个市场准入成本理论，其中企业需权衡内部提供的管理压力与外包的适应成本——这一机制得到了实证支持。进一步研究表明，外包市场准入服务有助于解释与引力模型及扩展引力模型相关的准入成本差异，同时影响出口的沉没成本和固定成本，并显著放大了贸易自由化带来的品种增益。

title: The Variance Premium and Seasonal Momentum in Option Returns
title_zh: 期权收益中的方差溢价与季节性动量
title_primary: 期权收益中的方差溢价与季节性动量
title_secondary: The Variance Premium and Seasonal Momentum in Option Returns
authors: Steven L Heston, Christopher S Jones, Mehdi Khorram, Shuaiqi Li, Haitao Mo

abstract: We develop a model-free measure of the variance premium by constructing option portfolios whose returns are highly correlated with realized stock variance. This effectively decomposes returns into realized variance minus implied variance. We apply this decomposition to document a novel quarterly cross-sectional continuation pattern in both realized variance and implied variance of individual stocks. Implied variance underanticipates the seasonality of realized variance, so options that performed well at quarterly lags continue to earn high returns in the future. Quarterly periodicity in realized stock variance only occurs on days with analyst earning revisions, suggesting an informational channel for this pattern. (JEL G12, G13, G40)
abstract_zh: 我们通过构建与已实现股票方差高度相关的期权组合，开发了一种无模型的方差溢价度量方法。该方法有效将收益分解为已实现方差减去隐含方差。我们运用这一分解，揭示了个股已实现方差与隐含方差在季度层面存在新颖的横截面延续模式。隐含方差未能充分预期已实现方差的季节性特征，因此在季度滞后期间表现优异的期权，未来仍能持续获得高收益。已实现股票方差的季度周期性仅出现在分析师盈利修正的交易日，表明该模式存在信息渠道机制。（JEL G12, G13, G40）

title: Routine Actuarial Adjustments Cut Taxpayer Cost in Subsidized Agricultural Insurance
title_zh: 精算常规调整降低补贴型农业保险的纳税人成本
title_primary: 精算常规调整降低补贴型农业保险的纳税人成本
title_secondary: Routine Actuarial Adjustments Cut Taxpayer Cost in Subsidized Agricultural Insurance
authors: Francis Tsiboe
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Government‐subsidized agricultural insurance plays a vital role in farm risk management but exposes taxpayers to substantial fiscal risk, intensifying debates over program efficiency and fiscal restraint. Using more than 3 million observations across 32 U.S. commodities from 2001 to 2024, this study evaluates how routine adjustments to rating parameters affect taxpayer costs. The results show that updating all ratemaking parameters reduces taxpayer expenditure by roughly 10% annually, while updating reference yields alone can generate savings of up to 15%. Although most states benefit, gains are uneven, underscoring the challenges of achieving actuarially and fiscally sound pricing.
abstract_zh: 摘要 政府补贴的农业保险在农场风险管理中扮演着关键角色，但同时也使纳税人面临巨大的财政风险，加剧了关于项目效率与财政约束的辩论。本研究利用2001年至2024年间美国32种商品超过300万条观测数据，评估了费率参数常规调整对纳税人成本的影响。结果显示，更新所有费率制定参数可使纳税人支出每年减少约10%，而仅更新参考产量即可节省高达15%的费用。尽管大多数州受益，但收益分布不均，凸显了实现精算与财政上合理定价所面临的挑战。

title: Welfare state and natives’ preferences for immigrants’ types
title_zh: 福利国家与本地居民对移民类型的偏好
title_primary: 福利国家与本地居民对移民类型的偏好
title_secondary: Welfare state and natives’ preferences for immigrants’ types
authors: Daiki Kishishita, Tomoko Matsumoto
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: When natives realize that their country’s welfare system includes immigrants, they may prefer high-income immigrants to low-income ones because the former will contribute more to the system because of its redistributive nature. We examine this causal effect using a novel survey experiment. In the experiment, we randomly assign half of the respondents to receive information designed to increase their perception that the national healthcare insurance system includes immigrants. Subsequently, we assess respondents’ preferences for different types of immigrants through a conjoint experiment. Our findings reveal that the treatment reduced preferences for low-income immigrants but increased preferences for high-income immigrants. Furthermore, these effects were observed only among those who did not perceive an increase in foreign workers as a threat to their job security. Thus, concerns about the welfare system and job insecurity should not be considered in isolation. Overall, the results indicate that institutional design (particularly the redistributive structure of welfare systems) shapes political preferences regarding immigration policy.
abstract_zh: 当本地居民意识到本国的福利体系涵盖移民时，他们可能更倾向于高收入移民而非低收入移民，因为前者由于福利体系的再分配性质，将为该体系贡献更多。我们通过一项新颖的问卷调查实验来考察这一因果效应。在实验中，我们随机分配一半的受访者接收旨在增强其认知——即国家医疗保险体系包含移民——的信息。随后，我们通过一个联合实验评估受访者对不同类型移民的偏好。研究结果显示，该处理降低了对低收入移民的偏好，但增加了对高收入移民的偏好。此外，这些效应仅出现在那些不认为外籍工人增加对其工作安全构成威胁的受访者中。因此，对福利体系的担忧与工作不安全感不应被孤立考虑。总体而言，结果表明制度设计（尤其是福利体系的再分配结构）塑造了关于移民政策的政治偏好。

title: Heterogeneity in Imperfect Inflation Expectations: Theory and Evidence from a Novel Survey
title_zh: 不完全通胀预期中的异质性：基于新调查的理论与证据
title_primary: 不完全通胀预期中的异质性：基于新调查的理论与证据
title_secondary: Heterogeneity in Imperfect Inflation Expectations: Theory and Evidence from a Novel Survey
authors: ALISTAIR MACAULAY, JAMES MOBERLY
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using survey data from Germany, we study heterogeneity in how households form inflation expectations. We elicit (i) uncertainty in perceptions of current inflation and (ii) how persistent households perceive inflation to be. Combining these with standard survey questions on inflation, we infer laws of motion for expectations at the individual level. Based on averages alone, a standard model calibrated to our data predicts inflation shocks generate small and transitory responses in expectations and consumption. The considerable heterogeneity we observe in expectation formation, however, amplifies the transmission to aggregate consumption by an order of magnitude, and substantially increases its persistence. This amplification enables the model to match the large consumption effects of the temporary Value Added Tax (VAT) cut in Germany in 2020.
abstract_zh: 利用德国的调查数据，我们研究了家庭在形成通胀预期方面的异质性。我们分别获取了（i）对当前通胀感知的不确定性，以及（ii）家庭认为通胀的持续性程度。结合标准调查问卷中关于通胀的问题，我们推断出个体层面预期的动态变化规律。仅基于平均值，一个根据我们数据校准的标准模型预测，通胀冲击对预期和消费产生的影响既小且短暂。然而，我们在预期形成过程中观察到的显著异质性，将传导至总消费的效应放大了一个数量级，并显著增强了其持续性。这种放大效应使模型能够匹配2020年德国临时增值税（VAT）削减所带来的大规模消费影响。

title: Is there a business case for banks to increase lending to women and women-led firms? Cross-country evidence on financial performance
title_zh: 银行增加对女性和女性领导企业贷款的商业理由是否存在？跨国财务绩效证据
title_primary: 银行增加对女性和女性领导企业贷款的商业理由是否存在？跨国财务绩效证据
title_secondary: Is there a business case for banks to increase lending to women and women-led firms? Cross-country evidence on financial performance
authors: Christoph Sommer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Financial constraints are one of the most severe obstacles for the operation and development of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), especially in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Yet women and women-led enterprises are disproportionally affected, which leads to a gender gap in access to finance. This paper uses panel estimation techniques, namely a correlated random effects model, for 1,655 financial institutions from 109 mostly LMICs for the years 2000 to 2019 to examine empirically whether there are purely economic incentives for financial institutions to scale up their lending activities towards women and women-led enterprises. Going beyond the microfinance sector, this study provides – to the best of my knowledge – the first empirical evidence on this question for banks and bank-like financial institutions that serve higher credit market segments. I find positive and significant effects on the quality of the loan portfolio (lower portfolio at risk), income streams (higher portfolio yield) and the overall financial performance (captured by return on assets or profit margin). Since economic incentives and profitability considerations are crucial in steering the decisions of financial institutions with regard to credit allocations, the banks’ self-interest could lead to management decisions and internal directives to favor female loan applicants, which could contribute to closing the gender gap in access to finance. Furthermore, the findings on the positive effects on banks’ financial performance give policymakers and regulators leeway to push financial institutions through more restrictive policy measures and regulatory requirements to direct more loans to women and women-led firms.
abstract_zh: 融资约束是中小企业（SMEs）运营与发展面临的最严重障碍之一，尤其是在中低收入国家（LMICs）。然而，女性及其领导的企业受到的影响尤为严重，这导致了融资获取方面的性别差距。本文采用面板估计技术，即相关随机效应模型，对来自109个主要为中低收入国家的1,655家金融机构在2000年至2019年间的数据进行了实证分析，以探讨金融机构扩大对女性和女性领导企业的贷款活动是否存在纯粹的经济激励。超越小额信贷领域，本研究——据我所知——首次为服务于更高信贷市场细分领域的银行及类似银行金融机构提供了关于这一问题的实证证据。我发现，贷款组合质量（组合风险降低）、收入流（组合收益率提高）以及整体财务绩效（以资产回报率或利润率衡量）均呈现出积极且显著的影响。由于经济激励和盈利性考量在引导金融机构信贷分配决策中至关重要，银行的自利动机可能促使管理层决策和内部指令倾向于女性贷款申请人，这有助于缩小融资获取方面的性别差距。此外，关于银行财务绩效积极影响的研究发现，为政策制定者和监管机构提供了空间，通过更具限制性的政策措施和监管要求，推动金融机构将更多贷款导向女性和女性领导的企业。

title: How important are within‐occupation task changes for wage growth? Evidence from administrative micro data
title_zh: 职业内任务变化对工资增长的重要性：基于行政微观数据的证据
title_primary: 职业内任务变化对工资增长的重要性：基于行政微观数据的证据
title_secondary: How important are within‐occupation task changes for wage growth? Evidence from administrative micro data
authors: Ronald Bachmann, Gökay Demir, Colin Green, Arne Uhlendorff
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine how changes in task content over time condition occupational wage development. Using survey data from Germany, we document substantial heterogeneity in within‐occupation changes in task content. Combining this evidence with administrative data on individual employment outcomes over a 25‐year period, we find important heterogeneity in wage penalties amongst jobs that were initially routine‐task‐intensive. While occupations that remain (relatively) routine‐intensive generate substantial wage penalties, occupations with a decreasing routine intensity experience stable or even increasing wages. These findings suggest that changing task profiles of occupations is an important adaptation mechanism to technological change. They cannot be explained by composition or cohort effects.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了任务内容随时间的变化如何影响职业工资发展。利用德国调查数据，我们记录了职业内部任务内容变化的显著异质性。结合25年间个体就业结果的行政数据，我们发现初始常规任务密集型岗位的工资惩罚存在重要异质性。那些保持（相对）常规密集型的职业会产生显著的工资惩罚，而常规强度下降的职业则经历工资稳定甚至增长。这些发现表明，职业任务特征的改变是应对技术变革的重要适应机制，且无法通过构成效应或队列效应加以解释。

title: The show must go on: The role of public financial support in promoting firm innovation investments during a crisis
title_zh: 演出必须继续：公共财政支持在危机中促进企业创新投资的作用
title_primary: 演出必须继续：公共财政支持在危机中促进企业创新投资的作用
title_secondary: The show must go on: The role of public financial support in promoting firm innovation investments during a crisis
authors: Marc Cowling, Luca Farè, Silvio Vismara
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: During crises, public financial support primarily aims to stabilize firms’ cash flows to sustain their operations. However, beyond this intended objective, such support may produce additional outcomes that remain underexplored. This study examines whether the public loan guarantee schemes introduced in the UK during the economic downturn due to the Covid-19 pandemic helped firms address new investment opportunities. Based on opportunity identification theory and using privileged data from UK public institutions covering the 2020–2023 period, we hypothesize and document that firms receiving public financial support are more likely to identify and pursue new innovation-related investment opportunities.
abstract_zh: 危机期间，公共财政支持的主要目标是稳定企业现金流以维持其运营。然而，除了这一预期目标外，此类支持可能产生尚未充分探索的额外效果。本研究考察了英国在新冠疫情导致的经济衰退期间推出的公共贷款担保计划是否帮助企业把握新的投资机会。基于机会识别理论，并利用覆盖2020至2023年期间的英国公共机构特权数据，我们假设并证实，获得公共财政支持的企业更有可能识别并追求与创新相关的新投资机会。

title: An empirical evaluation of some long-horizon macroeconomic forecasts
title_zh: 一些长期宏观经济预测的实证评估
title_primary: 一些长期宏观经济预测的实证评估
title_secondary: An empirical evaluation of some long-horizon macroeconomic forecasts
authors: Kurt G. Lunsford, Kenneth D. West
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-03-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We use long-run annual cross-country data for 10 macroeconomic variables to evaluate the long-horizon forecast distributions of six forecasting models. The variables we use range from ones having little serial correlation to ones having persistence consistent with unit roots. Our forecasting models include simple time series models and frequency domain models developed in Müller and Watson (2016). For plausibly stationary variables, an AR(1) model and a frequency domain model that does not require the user to take a stand on the order of integration appear reasonably well calibrated for forecast horizons of 10 and 25 years. For plausibly non-stationary variables, a random walk model appears reasonably well calibrated for forecast horizons of 10 and 25 years.
abstract_zh: 我们利用10个宏观经济变量的长期年度跨国数据，评估了六种预测模型在长预测期下的分布预测表现。所采用的变量范围从序列相关性极低到具有单位根一致性的持续性不等。我们的预测模型包括简单时间序列模型以及Müller和Watson（2016）提出的频域模型。对于可能平稳的变量，AR(1)模型和一种无需用户对积分阶数做出明确假设的频域模型，在10年和25年的预测期下，校准效果表现合理。对于可能非平稳的变量，随机游走模型在10年和25年的预测期下，校准效果同样表现合理。

title: Optimal Simple Ratings
title_zh: 最优简单评级
title_primary: 最优简单评级

authors: Hugo Hopenhayn, Maryam Saeedi
official: 官方在线 2026-03-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study optimal simple rating systems that partition sellers into a finite number of tiers. We show that optimal ratings must be threshold partitions, and that for linear supply and Cournot competition with constant marginal cost, optimal thresholds solve a k-means clustering problem requiring only the quality distribution. For convex (concave) supply functions, optimal thresholds are higher (lower) than the k-means solution. For log-concave distributions, two-tier certification captures at least 50% of maximum welfare gains from full disclosure, with five tiers typically achieving over 90%. Applications to eBay and Medicare Advantage data illustrate our method.
abstract_zh: 我们研究将卖家划分为有限等级的最优简单评级系统。我们证明，最优评级必须是阈值划分，并且在线性供给和恒定边际成本的古诺竞争下，最优阈值解决一个仅需质量分布的k均值聚类问题。对于凸（凹）供给函数，最优阈值高于（低于）k均值解。对于对数凹分布，两层认证能捕获完全信息披露下最大福利收益的至少50%，而五层通常能达到90%以上。对eBay和Medicare Advantage数据的应用展示了我们的方法。

title: Investor Activism and the Green Transition
title_zh: 投资者行动主义与绿色转型
title_primary: 投资者行动主义与绿色转型
title_secondary: Investor Activism and the Green Transition
authors: Sebastian Gryglewicz, Simon Mayer, Erwan Morellec
official: 官方在线 2026-02-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study impact activism, where activist investors promote green transitions in firms. This activism faces two key challenges. First, an internal free-rider problem arises when insiders and activists free-ride on each other's efforts, weakening activism's effectiveness. Second, an external free-rider problem emerges when gains from activism are reflected in stock prices, discouraging activist investment or tilting it towards firms capable of transitioning independently. Our analysis highlights how factors such as investor preferences, carbon taxes, and firms’ ownership structure — public versus private — shape the effectiveness of activism, clarifying the conditions under which activism supports, rather than hinders, firms’ green transition.
abstract_zh: 我们研究影响力行动主义，即积极投资者推动企业绿色转型。这种行动主义面临两大关键挑战。其一，内部搭便车问题：当内部人与行动主义者相互依赖对方的努力而坐享其成时，会削弱行动主义的有效性。其二，外部搭便车问题：当行动主义带来的收益反映在股价中时，会抑制行动主义投资，或使其偏向于能够独立完成转型的企业。我们的分析揭示了投资者偏好、碳税以及企业所有权结构（公有与私有）等因素如何塑造行动主义的有效性，阐明了行动主义在何种条件下能够促进而非阻碍企业的绿色转型。

title: Debt and Taxes: The Role of Tax Avoidance

authors: Brok, Peter
source: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis

abstract: Abstract Empirically, the effect of corporate tax rates on leverage has been smaller than expected based on trade-off theory. In this article, I show that tax avoidance functions as a non-debt tax shield, reducing the benefits of the debt tax shield. I find that higher tax rates cause higher non-debt tax avoidance, which crowds out the debt tax shield. Moreover, I show that the strength of the relationship between debt and tax rates depends on the level of tax avoidance. A 1-standard-deviation higher tax rate implies 2.8% higher leverage for low tax avoidance firms, but has a negative effect for high tax avoidance firms.
abstract_zh: 摘要 实证上，企业税率对杠杆的影响小于基于权衡理论的预期。本文表明，避税行为充当非债务税盾，降低了债务税盾的收益。我发现，较高的税率导致较高的非债务避税，从而挤出了债务税盾。此外，我展示了债务与税率之间关系的强度取决于避税水平。税率每提高一个标准差，低避税企业的杠杆率将提高2.8%，但对高避税企业则产生负面影响。

title: The Ripple Effects of China’s College Expansion on American Universities
title_zh: 中国高校扩招对美国大学的涟漪效应
title_primary: 中国高校扩招对美国大学的涟漪效应
title_secondary: The Ripple Effects of China’s College Expansion on American Universities
authors: Ruixue Jia, Gaurav Khanna, Hongbin Li, Yuli Xu
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: China’s unprecedented expansion of higher education in 1999, increased annual college enrollment from 1 million to 9.6 million by 2020. We trace the global ripple effects of that expansion by examining its impact on US graduate education and local economies surrounding college towns. Combining administrative data from China’s college admissions system and US visa data, we leverage the centralized quota system governing Chinese college admissions for identification and present three key findings. First, the expansion of Chinese undergraduate education drove graduate student flows to the US: every additional 100 college graduates in China led to 3.6 Chinese graduate students in the US. Second, Chinese master’s students generated positive spillovers, driving the birth of new master’s programs, and increasing the number of other international and American master's students, particularly in STEM fields. And third, the influx of international students supported local economies around college towns, raising job creation rates outside the universities, as well. Our findings highlight how domestic education policy in one country can reshape the academic and economic landscape of another through student migration and its broader spillovers.
abstract_zh: 中国1999年启动的高等教育史无前例的扩招，使年度大学招生人数从100万增至2020年的960万。我们通过考察该扩招对美国研究生教育及大学城周边地方经济的影响，追溯其全球涟漪效应。结合中国高考录取系统的行政数据与美国签证数据，我们利用中国大学招生的集中配额制度进行识别，得出三项核心发现：第一，中国本科教育的扩张推动了赴美研究生流动——中国每增加100名大学毕业生，美国便新增3.6名中国研究生；第二，中国硕士生产生正向溢出效应，催生新硕士项目设立，并带动其他国际学生及美国本土硕士生数量增长，尤其在STEM领域表现显著；第三，国际学生涌入为大学城周边地方经济提供支撑，同时提升了大学以外的就业岗位创造率。研究揭示了一国国内教育政策如何通过学生迁移及其广泛溢出效应，重塑另一国的学术与经济格局。

title: Do trade networks among countries along the Belt and Road Initiative promote technology progress?
title_zh: 一带一路”沿线国家贸易网络是否促进了技术进步？
title_primary: 一带一路”沿线国家贸易网络是否促进了技术进步？
title_secondary: Do trade networks among countries along the Belt and Road Initiative promote technology progress?
authors: Li Lin, Miaoru Chen, Yuting Yan, Lu Wang
official: 官方在线 2025-09-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The ongoing development of bilateral trade among countries participating in the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) promotes the creation of trade networks and the advancement of technology in these countries. This article utilizes social network analysis to investigate the characteristics of trade networks among the BRI and how these characteristics influence technological progress. Based on bilateral trade data from 2003 to 2019, the findings of this study indicate the following key insights: First, in terms of network structure, China occupies a central position within the trade network, and the overall network density exhibits an upward trend. Notably, key players in the trade network include China, India and Singapore, which exhibit high and stable levels of centrality, connectedness, and heterogeneity. Second, empirical testing indicates that centrality, connectedness, and heterogeneity all contribute to technological advancement. Third, the varying levels of economic development among different countries significantly affect their technological progress. Lastly, the analysis suggests that increased trade liberalization enhances the impact of trade networks on technological progress in nations along the BRI.

title: Bridging the East-West environmental development gap in China: the role and mechanisms of the digital economy in promoting common prosperity
title_zh: 弥合中国东西部环境发展差距：数字经济促进共同富裕的作用与机制
title_primary: 弥合中国东西部环境发展差距：数字经济促进共同富裕的作用与机制
title_secondary: Bridging the East-West environmental development gap in China: the role and mechanisms of the digital economy in promoting common prosperity
authors: Bowen Li, Cancan Yang
official: 官方在线 2025-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study aims to examine the relationship between the digital economy and the environmental development gap between the eastern and western regions of China. Using urban panel data from 2003 to 2021, we apply the entropy method to measure the development levels of the digital economy and environmental performance across cities. The study systematically analyzes the impact and mechanisms of the digital economy in narrowing the environmental development gap. Furthermore, it examines the effects of its linkage on promoting regional convergence and common prosperity. The findings show that: First, the development of the digital economy significantly reduces the environmental development gap between the eastern and western regions. Second, mechanism analysis reveals that the digital economy promotes green technological innovation, improving carbon productivity and energy efficiency, thereby helping to narrow the gap. Third, the digital economy fosters environmental development in neighbouring cities, exhibiting significant spatial spillover effects. Fourth, digital economy exhibits significant linkage effects in promoting environmental equity and supporting the realization of common prosperity, with micro-level mechanisms indicating that the digital economy can increase the incomes of rural residents. Overall, the development of the digital economy not only narrows regional environmental disparities but also promotes broader economic and social objectives.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨数字经济与中国东西部地区环境发展差距之间的关系。利用2003年至2021年的城市面板数据，我们采用熵值法衡量各城市数字经济发展水平和环境绩效。研究系统分析了数字经济在缩小环境发展差距方面的影响及其作用机制，并进一步考察了其联动效应在促进区域趋同与共同富裕中的作用。研究发现：第一，数字经济的发展显著缩小了东西部地区之间的环境发展差距。第二，机制分析表明，数字经济促进绿色技术创新，提升碳生产率和能源效率，从而有助于缩小差距。第三，数字经济对邻近城市的环境发展具有促进作用，表现出显著的空间溢出效应。第四，数字经济在促进环境公平和支持实现共同富裕方面展现出显著的联动效应，微观层面的机制表明，数字经济能够增加农村居民收入。总体而言，数字经济的发展不仅缩小了区域环境差异，还推动了更广泛的经济和社会目标的实现。
